e.title: floodwise · 英格兰邮编级洪水风险查询（EA 官方数据，拒绝猜测）
e.title_en: floodwise — England flood risk by postcode (official Environment Agency data, refuses to guess)
e.title_hk: floodwise · 英格蘭郵編級洪水風險查詢（EA 官方數據，拒絕猜測）
e.summary: 按邮编查英格兰长期洪水风险等级，源自环境署官方数据；查不到就明说「not found」，并写明覆盖与用途边界
e.summary_en: Postcode-level long-term flood risk for England from official Environment Agency data; returns an honest "not found" rather than a guess, and states its coverage and use limits
e.summary_hk: 按郵編查英格蘭長期洪水風險等級，源自環境署官方數據；查不到就明說「not found」，並寫明覆蓋與用途邊界
e.body:
**floodwise** 是一个小而诚实的 MCP 服务器：**按邮编查英格兰的长期洪水风险等级**。可核实信息：**Apache-2.0**、仓库 `github.com/qinisolabs/floodwise`（**★1**、**2026-06-18 创建、2026-06-22 最后推送**、**52 KB**、**TypeScript**、**实测 27 个文件**）、npm 包 `floodwise`（**v0.1.1**，Apache-2.0，2026-06-18 创建、2026-06-22 更新，**2 个版本**）、文档站 `qinisolabs.github.io/floodwise/`（HTTP 200，8.5KB）实测。运行方式为**本地 stdio，无需 key、无需登录**（`npx -y floodwise`）。文件结构中可见 `src/flood.ts`、`src/core.ts`、`src/server.ts`、`src/worker.ts`、`scripts/build-data.mjs` 与 `gen-data.mjs`、`data/flood-postcodes.sample.json`、`test/parity.test.ts`、`manifest.json`、`smithery.yaml`、`docs/llms.txt`。

**它解决的是一个「模型根本不可能知道」的问题**（README 原文）：问 LLM「SW1A 1AA 的洪水风险如何」，它会自信作答——但它**不可能知道**：**逐邮编的洪水风险是存放在政府数据集里的具体数据，不在模型权重里**。floodwise 则去 **环境署（Environment Agency）官方的「Flood risk: postcode search tool」数据集**里查，**返回真实的长期风险等级，查不到就返回一个诚实的「not found」，而不是猜一个**。

**⭐ 这个项目最值得本 wiki 记录的是它把边界写在最前面**（README 单列一节「Read this first — what floodwise is and isn't」）：**① 仅英格兰**——数据来自环境署，覆盖英格兰；威尔士（Natural Resources Wales）、苏格兰（SEPA）、北爱尔兰（DfI）**不在覆盖范围内**，**有效的威/苏邮编会返回「not found」，绝不猜测**；**② 区域级而非物业级**——风险针对该邮编内地址**周边区域**，不是某一栋建筑，且**环境署自己声明该数据「generally not suitable for property level assessment」**；**③ 长期风险而非实时预警**——反映的是长期年度洪涝概率，**不是「此刻或预报是否正在淹水」**；**④ 明确声明「不是保险、核保、勘测或专业建议」**。它给自己的定位是「**为 AI agent 提供经过核实的、可信的数据工具**」（项目方 Qiniso 的名称在祖鲁语中意为「真相」）。

**⭐ 连「示例数据」都不肯误导**：仓库里提交的 `flood-postcodes.sample.json` 开头写着——「**ILLUSTRATIVE STARTER SAMPLE — NOT official Environment Agency data**（仅用于让新克隆的仓库能在没有大数据集的情况下构建与测试）」，因此它使用**非地理性的 `ZZ` 伪邮编**（外加众所周知的低风险 `SW1A 1AA`），理由是「**so no real location is mislabelled（这样不会把任何真实地点标错）**」；真实数据由 `node scripts/build-data.mjs <Postcodes_Risk_Assessment_All.csv> <version>` 从环境署数据生成、不入库。**为了「不误导」而专门设计示例数据的键名与内容——这个做法本身就值得作为范例记录。**

对 RIAA：**① 业务上直接可用**——洪水是财产险与巨灾建模的核心风险，而**「按邮编查长期风险等级」是报价、承保筛选与组合暴露清点的第一步**；池内巨灾与自然灾害条目已很厚（[[perils-ied]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[climada]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[earth-engine]]、[[hazimp]]、[[anuga]]、[[noaa-inundation-mapping]]、[[thinkhazard]]、[[lisflood]]、[[floodmodeller-api]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]），美国的 NFIP/洪水口径也有 [[rfema]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]，但**「英国邮编级、直接可查询的洪水风险」这一条此前没有**（[[floodmodeller-api]] 是建模工具，不是查询数据源）；对做**英国市场**或**跨市场承保筛选**的学生，这是一个立刻能用的数据入口，可与 [[spatialrisk]]（风险集中度）、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]] 一类参数险工作串联。**② 方法上更值得学**——它是本 wiki 里**「数据源边界」写得最完整的一个小项目**：覆盖范围（英格兰）、空间粒度（区域非物业）、时间语义（长期非实时）、**用途免责（不是核保建议）**四项全部前置声明，**查不到就返回 not found**，示例数据都刻意避免误导。这与池内同类纪律的条目（[[claim-handling-deadlines-us]] 的逐条引文、上一轮 [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]] 的字段级置信度、[[quorumforge]] 的确定性裁决、[[clarity-sdk]] 的确定性受监管抽取、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] 的可靠性评测）构成同一个主题：**面向 agent 的数据供给，可信度必须被显式设计，而不是默认成立**。相关：[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[underwriting-intel-mcp]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]、[[insurance-deploy]]、[[usgs-earthquake-api]]、[[gdacs]]、[[open-meteo]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ★1、项目极小**（52 KB、27 个文件、npm 仅 **2 个版本**、最后推送 2026-06-22 后再无活动），属**个人/小团队早期项目**，长期维护无保障；**② 覆盖仅英格兰**——对香港、中国内地或美国市场的读者，其价值主要在**形态与做法**，而非可直接使用的数据；**③** 本次核实到仓库文件树、README 原文、npm 元数据与文档站层面，**未运行该 MCP、未实际查询任何邮编、未与企业环境署原始 CSV 比对结果**；**④** README 引述的「EA 称该数据 generally not suitable for property level assessment」**为项目转述环境署表述，本次未回环境署原文核对**；**⑤** 它**明确声明不构成核保或专业建议**——本词条同样不主张可据此直接承保定价。**核实说明**：npm registry 元数据、GitHub 仓库页（320KB）与完整文件树（27 文件）、README 原文、示例数据文件原文、文档站（8.5KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未运行、未查询、未回源比对**。
e.body_en:
**floodwise** is a small and unusually honest MCP server: **look up England’s long-term flood risk by postcode**. Verifiable details: **Apache-2.0**, repository `github.com/qinisolabs/floodwise` (**1 star**, **created 2026-06-18, last pushed 2026-06-22**, **52 KB**, **TypeScript**, **27 files measured**), npm package `floodwise` (**v0.1.1**, Apache-2.0, created 2026-06-18, updated 2026-06-22, **two versions**), and docs site `qinisolabs.github.io/floodwise/` (measured HTTP 200, 8.5KB). It runs **locally over stdio with no key and no login** (`npx -y floodwise`). The file tree shows `src/flood.ts`, `src/core.ts`, `src/server.ts`, `src/worker.ts`, `scripts/build-data.mjs` and `gen-data.mjs`, `data/flood-postcodes.sample.json`, `test/parity.test.ts`, `manifest.json`, `smithery.yaml` and `docs/llms.txt`.

**It solves a problem a model simply cannot know** (per the README): ask an LLM "what’s the flood risk at SW1A 1AA?" and it will answer confidently — but it **cannot know**, because **per-postcode flood risk is specific curated data living in a government dataset, not in a model’s weights**. floodwise instead looks the postcode up in the **Environment Agency’s official "Flood risk: postcode search tool" data** and returns the **real long-term risk band — or an honest "not found" instead of a guess**.

**⭐ What most deserves recording here is that it puts its boundaries first** (the README devotes a section to "Read this first — what floodwise is and isn’t"): **① England only** — the data is the Environment Agency’s, which covers England; Wales (Natural Resources Wales), Scotland (SEPA) and Northern Ireland (DfI) are **not covered**, and **a valid Welsh or Scottish postcode returns "not found", never a guess**; **② area-level, not property-level** — the risk is for *the area around* the addresses in a postcode rather than a specific building, and the **EA itself states the data is "generally not suitable for property level assessment"**; **③ long-term risk, not a live warning** — it reflects the long-term annual chance of flooding, **not whether flooding is happening now or forecast**; **④ an explicit statement that it is "not insurance, underwriting, surveying or professional advice"**. Its own framing: "**Verified, trustworthy data tools for AI agents**" (the maker, Qiniso, means "truth" in Zulu).

**⭐ It will not even let its sample data mislead**: the committed `flood-postcodes.sample.json` opens with "**ILLUSTRATIVE STARTER SAMPLE — NOT official Environment Agency data**", committed so a fresh clone can build and test without the large real dataset; it therefore uses **non-geographic `ZZ` pseudo-postcodes** (plus the well-known low-risk `SW1A 1AA`) on the stated grounds "**so no real location is mislabelled**". The real data is produced by `node scripts/build-data.mjs <Postcodes_Risk_Assessment_All.csv> <version>` from EA data and is not committed. **Designing the sample file’s keys and contents specifically so it cannot mislead is itself worth recording as a model practice.**

For RIAA: **① direct business use** — flooding is a core property and catastrophe-modelling peril, and **"look up the long-term risk band by postcode" is the first step in quoting, underwriting screening and portfolio exposure inventory**. The corpus’s catastrophe and natural-hazard coverage is already deep ([[perils-ied]], [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[climada]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[openquake-engine]], [[earth-engine]], [[hazimp]], [[anuga]], [[noaa-inundation-mapping]], [[thinkhazard]], [[lisflood]], [[floodmodeller-api]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[opendrr-riskprofiler]], [[canada-seismic-risk-model]]), and the US NFIP/flood angle is covered by [[rfema]], [[fema-nfhl-mcp]] and [[duckdb-fema-nfip]] — but **a UK postcode-level, directly queryable flood risk source had no entry** ([[floodmodeller-api]] is a modelling tool, not a queryable data source); for students working on the **UK market** or **cross-market underwriting screening**, this is a usable data entry point that chains with [[spatialrisk]] (risk concentration), [[aegis-parametric]] and [[parametric-insurance-demo]]. **② The method matters more** — it is **the most complete statement of data-source boundaries** among the corpus’s small projects: coverage (England), spatial granularity (area, not property), temporal semantics (long-term, not live) and **purpose disclaimer (not underwriting advice)** are all declared up front, **unknown lookups return not found**, and even the sample data is built to avoid misleading. That places it with the corpus’s other entries on the same discipline — the per-record citations of [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]], the field-level confidence of last round’s [[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]], the deterministic adjudication of [[quorumforge]], the deterministic regulated extraction of [[clarity-sdk]] and the reliability evaluation of [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] — all instances of one theme: **in agent-facing data supply, trustworthiness has to be designed in, not assumed**. Related: [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[underwriting-intel-mcp]], [[agentic-bop-underwriting]], [[insurance-deploy]], [[usgs-earthquake-api]], [[gdacs]], [[open-meteo]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① at 1 star and very small** (52 KB, 27 files, only **two npm versions**, no activity since 2026-06-22), it is an **early project from an individual or small team** with no maintenance guarantee; **② coverage is England only** — for readers in Hong Kong, mainland China or the US its value lies mainly in **form and practice** rather than directly usable data; **③** this check reached the file tree, README text, npm metadata and docs site — **the MCP was not run, no postcode was queried and no result was compared against the Environment Agency’s original CSV**; **④** the README’s quotation that the EA calls the data "generally not suitable for property level assessment" **is the project paraphrasing the EA and was not traced back to the EA’s own text here**; **⑤** it **explicitly disclaims underwriting or professional advice**, and this entry likewise does not claim it can be used directly for pricing. **Verification note**: npm registry metadata, the GitHub repository page (320KB) with its full file tree (27 files), the README, the sample data file and the docs site (8.5KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **nothing was run or queried, and no source comparison was made**.
e.body_hk:
**floodwise** 是一個小而誠實的 MCP 伺服器：**按郵編查英格蘭的長期洪水風險等級**。可核實資訊：**Apache-2.0**、倉庫 `github.com/qinisolabs/floodwise`（**★1**、**2026-06-18 建立、2026-06-22 最後推送**、**52 KB**、**TypeScript**、**實測 27 個檔案**）、npm 包 `floodwise`（**v0.1.1**，**2 個版本**）、文檔站 HTTP 200 實測。運行方式為**本地 stdio，無需 key、無需登入**（`npx -y floodwise`）。

**它解決的是一個「模型根本不可能知道」的問題**（README 原文）：問 LLM「SW1A 1AA 的洪水風險如何」，它會自信作答——但它**不可能知道**：**逐郵編的洪水風險是存放在政府數據集裡的具體數據，不在模型權重裡**。floodwise 則去**環境署官方的「Flood risk: postcode search tool」數據集**裡查，**返回真實的長期風險等級，查不到就返回誠實的「not found」，而不是猜一個**。

**⭐ 最值得記錄的是它把邊界寫在最前面**：**① 僅英格蘭**——威爾斯、蘇格蘭、北愛爾蘭**不在覆蓋範圍內**，**有效的威/蘇郵編返回「not found」，絕不猜測**；**② 區域級而非物業級**——且**環境署自己聲明該數據「generally not suitable for property level assessment」**；**③ 長期風險而非實時預警**；**④ 明確聲明「不是保險、核保、勘測或專業建議」**。

**⭐ 連「示例數據」都不肯誤導**：`flood-postcodes.sample.json` 開頭寫明「**NOT official Environment Agency data**」，因此使用**非地理性的 `ZZ` 偽郵編**（外加眾所周知的低風險 `SW1A 1AA`），理由是「**so no real location is mislabelled**」。**為「不誤導」而專門設計示例數據——這個做法本身就值得作為範例記錄。**

對 RIAA：**① 業務上直接可用**——「按郵編查長期風險等級」是報價、承保篩選與組合暴露清點的第一步；池內巨災條目已很厚（[[perils-ied]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[climada]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[hazimp]]、[[thinkhazard]]、[[lisflood]]、[[floodmodeller-api]]），美國 NFIP 口徑也有 [[rfema]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]，但**「英國郵編級、可直接查詢的洪水風險」此前沒有**；**② 方法上更值得學**——它是本 wiki 裡**「數據源邊界」寫得最完整的小項目**：覆蓋範圍、空間粒度、時間語義、**用途免責**四項全部前置聲明，**查不到就 not found**，示例數據都刻意避免誤導。與 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]（逐條引文）、[[insurance-ai-regulation-mcp]]（欄位級置信度）、[[quorumforge]]、[[clarity-sdk]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] 構成同一主題：**面向 agent 的數據供給，可信度必須被顯式設計**。相關：[[spatialrisk]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[underwriting-intel-mcp]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]、[[usgs-earthquake-api]]、[[gdacs]]、[[open-meteo]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ★1、項目極小**（52 KB、27 檔案、npm 僅 **2 個版本**、2026-06-22 後無活動）；**② 覆蓋僅英格蘭**——對香港、內地或美國讀者，價值主要在**形態與做法**；**③** 本次核實到倉庫、README、npm 元數據與文檔站層面，**未運行、未查詢任何郵編、未與環境署原始 CSV 比對**；**④** README 引述的環境署表述**未回原文核對**；**⑤** 它**明確聲明不構成核保或專業建議**。**核實說明**：npm 元數據、倉庫頁（320KB）與完整文件樹（27 檔案）、README 原文、示例數據原文、文檔站均 HTTP 200 實測；**未運行、未查詢、未回源比對**。
